questions.stem_text:
A small business estimates price elasticity of demand for the product to be 3. To raise
total revenue, owners should

options.A: keep the price constant as demand is elastic.
options.B: decrease price as demand is inelastic.
options.C: decrease the quality of the product.
options.D: increase price as demand is elastic.
options.E: increase price as demand is inelastic.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - keep the price constant as demand is elastic.

questions.stem_text:
Suppose the government seeks to achieve a balanced budgetby levying taxes of $100 billion
and making expendituresof $100 billion. How will this affect NNP if MPC = 0.8?

options.D: No change in NNP because taxes cancel out expenditures

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Decrease of \$500 billion in NNP

questions.stem_text: A minimum wage in the market for fast-food workers is likely to produce

options.A: a decrease in the demand for fast-food workers.
options.B: a stabilization in the market for fast-food workers.
options.C: a decrease in the supply of fast-food workers.
options.D: a decrease in the prices of fast-food items.
options.E: no change in the market for fast-food workers.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - a decrease in the demand for fast-food workers.

questions.stem_text:
Which one of the following is a disadvantage of the general to specific or "LSE"
("Hendry") approach to building econometric models, relative to the specific to general
approach?

options.A: Some variables may be excluded at the first stage leading to coefficient biases
options.B: The final model may lack theoretical interpretation
options.C: The final model may be statistically inadequate
options.D: If the initial model is mis-specified, all subsequent steps will be invalid.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The final model may lack theoretical interpretation
